title: InstaAuto - Open-Source ManyChat Alternative for Instagram DMs
content:
Paid Instagram automation tools mehange
padte hain jab contact count badhta hai.
Aaj ek open-source option dikhaata hoon:
INSTAAUTO.
Self-hosted ManyChat-style flows for
Instagram DMs, comments, stories, aur AI
replies.
Repo: github.com/ayuuxh2/insta-p8
Stack jo README claim karti hai: Next.js
plus Supabase, SELF-HOSTED.
Positioning: open-source ManyChat
alternative - DM automation, comment-to-DM
funnels, story automation, AI
auto-replies, live inbox.
Data tumhare Supabase mein rehta hai,
monthly SaaS lock-in nahi.
Early project hai, so production pe blind
trust mat karna.
What you can build with it, README ke hisaab se.
Keyword-based DM auto-replies.
Comment triggers that send a private DM.
Story automation.
AI fallback jab keyword match nahi hota,
with conversation history.
Live inbox jahan tum manual reply bhi le sakte ho.
Yeh exactly shop aur agency wala use case
hai jo aaj subah business reel mein tha.
How to use it safely - yeh part skip mat karna.
Step 1: local ya private server pe clone
karo, public secrets mat daalo.
Step 2: pehle DRAFT / APPROVE MODE socho,
auto-send later.
Step 3: hot keywords alag rakho - price,
booking, demo.
Step 4: spam aur "hi" pe AI ko free rein mat do.
Step 5: Meta policies aur rate limits
respect karo, warna account risk.
Sabse important: HUMAN HANDOFF.
Jaisi maine lead-qual agent mein kiya,
yahan bhi irreversible send ke pehle
approval rakho.
InstaAuto live inbox deta hai - usko empty
dashboard mat samjho.
Usse approval queue banao.
AI draft kare, tum approve karo.
Maan lo weekend pe tum ek test Instagram
account pe try karte ho.
Ek post pe comment keyword "PRICE" se DM funnel.
AI sirf rate-card se reply draft kare.
Tum 10 drafts review karke phir auto thoda
open karo.
Hypothetical test - main claim nahi kar
raha ki maine yeh repo production mein
deploy kiya.
Mera take simple hai.
Tools cheap hona enough nahi.
Guardrails cheap hone chahiye.
Open-source tab powerful hai jab tum
approval, logs, aur kill switch khud add
kar sako.
COMMENT INSTA, main link DM kar dunga.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
